G132.finding: Four individually reviewed PSU-student price-and-booking requests share the same Thai frame and differ in service/duration; three are in train and one in development under distinct original families. They are not identical factual questions, but the shared frame can overstate generalization to new phrasing.

G133.finding: Individually reviewed English price-for-audience/duration/service followed by booking questions141 and282 share a phrase frame across train/development; their audience, service, duration and factual answers differ. The relationship risks overstating generalization to new phrasing.

G134.finding: Existing semantic family gate required all group members to have the same original family, so it could not represent the independently identified shared-language groups while preserving their original identities.

G135.finding: Optimization admission accepted only three free-text metric blocks; it did not require the individual planner, executor and answer metrics or answerable/unanswerable denominators requested by the original Flow.

G136.finding: Existing cohort builders derive the training split directly from original file membership and cannot yet safely apply independently staged conservative development moves.

G137.finding: Training admission fingerprint covered training_contract.py but not the new semantic_family_plan.py helper even though migration decisions call it; a helper change could otherwise reuse an outdated runtime fingerprint.

G138.finding: Read-only source discovery for actual wheel-break and Switch-drop questions returned missing-source answers; spontaneous-break control returned no native answer. Source contains severity-based damage clauses but a drop or break does not itself establish cause, damage severity, or a fixed fine.

G139.finding: Actual CS2 pre-match and competition-area request returned no confirmed details despite source sections 015 and 050–053.

G140.finding: Actual 282 single-hour Cockpit price and booking had a 60-minute source rate with scoped numeric receipt, yet duration was always reported unverified. Multiple-duration alternatives remain unverified.

G141.finding: Actual R132 non-PSU guest question asking membership or national ID received generic access only; candidate source-only replay confirmed the omission.

G142.finding: R132 CS2 tournament schedule request received only the rulebook heading; candidate source replay reproduced the omission while source section015 contains actual timing rules.

G143.finding: R132 VALORANT teammate-boost question returned a generic exploit clause rather than the specific boosting condition; candidate source replay was missing despite source section025.
